targets.query: from(bucket: "monitoring") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu" and r._field == "usage_idle" and r.host == "pi-monitor" and r.cpu == "cpu-total") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: 100.0 - r._value}))

from(bucket: "monitoring") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mem" and r._field == "used_percent" and r.host == "pi-monitor") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
